description: This file defines the Rectangle class used for calculating expected dimensions of an image after rotation, considering different algorithms and PHP versions. It includes methods for rotating rectangles and handling imprecision issues.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: A class for calculating the dimensions of a rectangle after rotation, accounting for algorithm differences and imprecision corrections.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Rectangle with specified width and height, throws exception if dimensions are invalid.

methods.name: rotate
methods.description: Rotates the rectangle by a given angle, calculating new bounding dimensions.

methods.name: fixImprecision
methods.description: Adjusts a float value to compensate for floating point imprecision.

methods.name: fraction
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of a float number, unsigned.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Calculates the difference of a fractional part from the closest integer boundary.

methods.name: getBoundingWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the rotated rectangle.

methods.name: getBoundingHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the rotated rectangle.
